extraction: Read-only SQLite and Qt zlib decoding; full vendor page is not distributed.
paraphrased_notes: IM1 is equal-tone fundamental output power; IMn is the specified homogeneous intermod product output power in dBm.
Output intercept OIPn equals IM1 + (IM1 - IMn)/(n - 1).
The examples [-10,-80,-140] and [0,-60,-110] describe output IP2=60 and IP3=55 dBm.
The model requires every level through the desired order, and warns against using the total of overlapping orders as a homogeneous measurement.
The explanatory text discusses up to twenty orders, while the parameter enumeration and the RFModel implementation used here stop at eleven.
rfmodel_policy: Explicit real coefficient signs are supplied by the caller; no SystemVue default phase rule is claimed.
This documents a parameter conversion, not new SystemVue RFAMP_HO simulation evidence.
